Abraham Palatnik (Natal, 19 de fevereiro de 1928) é um artista plástico brasileiro. É um dos pioneiros e a maior referência em arte cinética no Brasil. Solenidade de inauguração da exposição do Prêmio Marcantonio Vilaça no Museu Histórico Nacional. Abraham Palatnik, artista homenageado. Schiahorn near Davos with light installation from Ulrich Studer in the night from 15 August to 16 August 2004.

40 megaphones of different sizes and capacities are fixed to an aluminum grid made in the shape of a bell. All audio inputs are grouped together and connected to one single microphone. The microphone is hanging in the center of the bell just below the megaphones. Only a temporary de-energized system prevents the inevitable audio feedback. As soon as the visitors disturb the microphone from its suspended state, the audio system automatically starts up and the deafening roar of a 40-megaphone chorus of amplified feedback collapses on the bell-ringer.

Cast iron mechanical banks in the shape of an owl sitting on a tree limb. To make a deposit, a coin is placed on the left of the owl's head; a lever turns the owl's head, pushing the coin into the bank. Manufactured by the J and E Stevens Company circa 1880. Title: Owl Mechanical Coin Bank

Shallow ribbed glass bowls are a fairly common ancient glass vessel type, likely made by blowing or pressing molten glass into molds. After cooling, an artisan would rotate the bowl on a wheel or lathe, using a gentle abrasive to smooth out imperfections.
